name: schedy-lint
description: ESLint for the app in ../../src. Kept in its own folder because typescript-eslint cannot run on TypeScript 7 (it needs the compiler's JavaScript API, which 7 does not have), so this folder pins TypeScript 5.9 for linting only. The app itself is still type-checked with the root TypeScript (npm run typecheck). Merge this into the root package.json once typescript-eslint supports TypeScript 7.
